display.label: Virtual Machine Scale Set
display.description: Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets to deploy and manage a group of load-balanced VMs

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Virtual Machine Scale Set identity, regional placement, and instance sizing.

fields.label: Scale Set Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Virtual Machine Scale Set. Must be 1-64 characters using alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens, and periods.

validation.pattern_error: Scale Set name must be 1-64 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Virtual Machine Scale Set.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Virtual Machine Scale Set should be created.

fields.label: SKU & Sizing
fields.description: Virtual machine instance size and capacity.

fields.label: VM Size / SKU
fields.description: Specifies the size of virtual machines in the scale set (e.g. Standard_B2s, Standard_D2s_v5).

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: Tier of virtual machines in the scale set.

fields.label: Instance Count (Capacity)
fields.description: Number of virtual machine instances to maintain in the scale set.

sections.label: Upgrade Policy
sections.description: Upgrade policy mode and rolling update configurations.

fields.label: Upgrade Policy Mode
fields.description: Specifies how updates are applied to virtual machines in the scale set.

fields.label: Automatic OS Upgrades
fields.description: Whether automatic OS patches should be applied by Azure to your scale set.

fields.label: Health Probe ID
fields.description: Identifier for the Load Balancer health probe. Required when upgrade policy mode is Rolling.

fields.label: Rolling Upgrade Policy
fields.description: Batch thresholds and wait times for rolling updates.

fields.label: Max Batch Instance Percent
fields.description: Maximum percentage of instances upgraded simultaneously in one batch.

fields.label: Max Unhealthy Instance Percent
fields.description: Maximum percentage of instances that can be simultaneously unhealthy.

fields.label: Max Unhealthy Upgraded Instance Percent
fields.description: Maximum percentage of upgraded instances that can be unhealthy before aborting.

fields.label: Pause Time Between Batches
fields.description: Wait time between completing updates in one batch and starting the next (ISO 8601 format, e.g. PT0S, PT1M).

sections.label: Operating System & Credentials
sections.description: Admin credentials, computer name prefix, and SSH keys.

fields.label: OS Profile
fields.description: Operating system administrator credentials and computer name prefix.

fields.label: Computer Name Prefix
fields.description: Prefix used for virtual machine computer names (1-58 chars for Linux, 1-9 for Windows).

fields.label: Admin Username
fields.description: Administrator account username for virtual machines in the scale set.

fields.label: Admin Password
fields.description: Administrator account password. Required for Windows or when password authentication is enabled.

fields.label: Custom Data / Cloud-Init Script
fields.description: Custom cloud-init script or startup data supplied to instances.

fields.label: Linux Configuration
fields.description: Linux authentication and SSH key configuration.

fields.label: Disable Password Authentication
fields.description: Whether password authentication should be disabled in favor of SSH keys.

fields.label: SSH Public Keys
fields.description: List of SSH public keys for authentication.

fields.label: Authorized Keys Path
fields.description: Path on destination VM (must be /home/<username>/.ssh/authorized_keys).

fields.label: SSH Public Key Data
fields.description: The public SSH key string (e.g. ssh-rsa AAAAB3...).

fields.label: Windows Configuration
fields.description: Windows-specific scale set settings.

fields.label: Provision VM Agent
fields.description: Indicates whether the VM Agent is provisioned on instances.

fields.label: Enable Automatic Updates
fields.description: Indicates whether automatic Windows Updates are enabled.

sections.label: Storage & Disks
sections.description: OS disk, image reference, and optional data disks.

fields.label: OS Disk Profile
fields.description: OS disk caching, managed disk type, and sizing.

fields.label: Caching
fields.description: Disk caching behavior.

fields.label: Managed Disk Type
fields.description: Storage type for the OS disk.

fields.label: Create Option
fields.description: Specifies how the OS disk is created.

fields.label: Disk Size (GB)
fields.description: Custom OS disk size in GB (optional override).

fields.label: Image Reference
fields.description: Platform marketplace image or custom image reference.

fields.label: Publisher
fields.description: Image publisher (e.g. Canonical, MicrosoftWindowsServer).

fields.label: Offer
fields.description: Image offer (e.g. 0001-com-ubuntu-server-jammy, WindowsServer).

fields.label: Image SKU
fields.description: Image SKU (e.g. 22_04-lts, 2022-datacenter-azure-edition).

fields.label: Image Version
fields.description: Image version or latest.

fields.label: Custom Image ID
fields.description: Resource ID of a custom gallery image (mutually exclusive with publisher/offer/sku).

fields.label: Data Disks
fields.description: Additional data disks attached to instances.

fields.label: LUN
fields.description: Logical Unit Number of the disk.

fields.label: Disk Size (GB)
fields.description: Size of the data disk in GB.

fields.label: Managed Disk Type
fields.description: Storage tier of the data disk.

fields.label: Caching
fields.description: Caching requirements.

sections.label: Networking
sections.description: Network profiles, subnet associations, and load balancer backend pool attachments.

fields.label: Network Profiles
fields.description: Network interface configurations for scale set instances.

fields.label: Network Profile Name
fields.description: Name of the network interface configuration.

fields.label: Primary Network Profile
fields.description: Whether this is the primary NIC of the instances.

fields.label: Accelerated Networking
fields.description: Enables Single Root I/O Virtualization (SR-IOV) for low latency.

fields.label: IP Forwarding
fields.description: Whether IP forwarding is enabled on this NIC.

fields.label: Network Security Group ID
fields.description: Identifier for the Network Security Group to attach to this NIC profile.

fields.label: IP Configurations
fields.description: Subnet and load balancer backend pool attachments.

fields.label: IP Config Name
fields.description: Name of the IP configuration.

fields.label: Primary IP Configuration
fields.description: Whether this is the primary IP configuration.

fields.label: Subnet Resource ID
fields.description: ID of the Subnet where instances are deployed.

fields.label: Load Balancer Backend Pool IDs
fields.description: List of Backend Address Pool IDs of Load Balancers.

fields.label: Load Balancer Inbound NAT Pool IDs
fields.description: List of Inbound NAT Pool IDs for port forwarding.

fields.label: App Gateway Backend Pool IDs
fields.description: List of Application Gateway backend pool IDs.

fields.label: Application Security Group IDs
fields.description: List of Application Security Group IDs.

sections.label: Placement & Resilience
sections.description: Availability zones, priority, overprovisioning, and placement group settings.

fields.label: Instance Priority
fields.description: Priority for instances in the scale set (Regular or Low for Spot instances).

fields.label: Eviction Policy
fields.description: Eviction policy when priority is Low.

fields.label: Availability Zones
fields.description: List of availability zones to distribute instances across (e.g. ['1', '2', '3']).

fields.label: Single Placement Group
fields.description: Whether the scale set is limited to a single placement group (max 100 VMs). Set to false for up to 1000 VMs.

fields.label: Overprovisioning
fields.description: Whether Azure launches extra VMs during scaling up to ensure requested capacity is reached quickly.

fields.label: Proximity Placement Group ID
fields.description: ID of Proximity Placement Group to colocate VMs physically close together.

sections.label: Identity & Diagnostics
sections.description: Managed Service Identity and Boot Diagnostics configurations.

fields.label: Managed Service Identity
fields.description: Azure Managed Service Identity configuration.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.description: Type of managed identity to assign.

fields.label: User Assigned Identity IDs
fields.description: List of user-assigned managed identity IDs.

fields.label: Boot Diagnostics
fields.description: Captures console logs and screenshots for debugging boot failures.

fields.label: Enable Boot Diagnostics
fields.description: Whether to enable boot diagnostics.

fields.label: Storage Account Endpoint
fields.description: Primary blob endpoint URI of storage account for diagnostic data.

sections.label: Tagging
sections.description: Resource tags for governance, categorization, and cost allocation.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the scale set.
